mobile.host.port.confirm: After changing the port this phone disconnects from “{0}” (the saved address stops working). Add the server again with the new port {1}.
mobile.host.removeSelfUser: This phone signed in with this account. Deleting it disconnects this phone from “{0}” right away; other devices that signed in with it are revoked too.
mobile.host.revokeSelf: This is the key this phone is using. Revoking it disconnects this phone from “{0}” right away; add the server again to reconnect.
mobile.settings.app.info: Language and theme only affect this phone; the server's settings are not changed.
mobile.settings.editor.info: Editor settings are stored on the server and shared by every device connected to it. The keymap applies to external keyboards; when none is chosen the phone uses the Windows keymap (Ctrl shortcuts). Keymaps and color themes come from plugins; install more from the store.
mobile.settings.serverSettings.info: The settings below are stored on this server and apply to every device connected to it.
mobile.store.versions.info: When installing, the server picks the newest version compatible with its core version and system.
